title: What Happens If You Are Late for a Boat Trip in Madeira?
description: Message the skipper on WhatsApp at once and keep coming. Return times stay as booked, and under Chifbay's terms a group that never turns up gets no refund.
heroAlt: A couple seen from behind walking quickly along the Funchal seafront towards the marina
keywords: what happens if you are late for a boat trip in Madeira
late for a boat tour Funchal
how early to arrive for a boat trip

images.prompt: Early afternoon on Avenida do Mar, the seafront promenade of Funchal, Madeira. Seen from behind and at street level, a couple walk briskly along the wide promenade paved with dark and light stone patterns towards Marina do Funchal, one holding a phone, the other with a small backpack and a rolled towel. A row of palm trees on the right, the masts of the small boats in the marina ahead on the left, the harbour wall and blue sea beyond. Bright sun, true colours, no faces, no readable signs or text.
